text.tspan: Share of global primary energy use by source
Measured as a percentage of total energy supply plus traditional biomass.
Data source: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Smil (2017)
Note: In the absence of more recent data, traditional biomass is assumed constant since 2015. Other renewables include geothermal, biomass,
